name: Grow
meaning: make a thing larger and stronger - a plant, a beast, or you
effect: reach x1.2; power x1.1; cost x1.1
why: Widened from things that grow in the ground to any living thing, so the druid's buff (Overgrowth) is built on it. Draws on Life's Strengthen. Role and draw kept (EN 2.15).

name: Sprout
why: Kept (EN 2.08). Now carries two skills (Thornburst and Heartwood): every rune has one, so a second is allowed.

name: Flourish
meaning: thrive: strengthen what grows, and what lives in it
why: Widened to the living things standing in the growth, so Greening buffs you and your beasts In the Green. Role and draw kept (EN 2.01).

name: Harvest
meaning: take what has grown, and its yield
why: Kept (EN 3.2); its yield now includes health (Life's half).

name: Sow
effect: windup x1.3; power x1.25; duration x1.2

name: Tangle
why: Kept (EN 2.74). Draws on Earth's Root: held in place.

name: Herd
meaning: gather beasts to you - called up out of the growth - and drive them onto your quarry
why: The role needs beasts and no rune called them. Draws on both parents: the ground gives them up (Earth, as it gives up stone) and they are alive (Life). Link: it takes in (calls to you) and passes on (to the quarry). Inward draw, EN = 2.5 + 0.6 x 1.0 = 3.1. As a means it marks a Quarry that your beasts hunt.

name: Unleash
meaning: let the bound go wild: a pack off its leash
why: The beast pair's other half: calling holds them to you, unleashing sends them out. Branch: it spreads out to every beast. Strongly outward, EN = 2.5 - 0.8 x 0.7 = 1.94. Distinct from Unravel, which frees what vines hold. (The pair was first named Beckon / Unleash; Unholy has Beckon.)
